normalFrameAnalysis.sourceComment: Cesium flips V and image together; green sampled unchanged
normalFrameAnalysis.currentShader: Kartoitettu uses derivative cotangent T/B, raw RGB*2-1 and scale. No additional green inversion in shader.
normalFrameAnalysis.ifUVUnflipped: Interior UV=(u/P,-v/P) gives tangent green basis -v; generated(-dhE,-dhN) would have a green sign discrepancy. This is not a verified target-runtime condition.
normalFrameAnalysis.ifDeclaredCesiumUVFlip: Imported V flip makes interior green basis+v. Recipe(-dhE,-dhN) is then consistent. West axes(E,N), north(-N,E), south(N,-E); code north(-y,x), south(y,-x) are the correct rotations for this declared basis.
normalFrameAnalysis.oldSource: Source-affine UV0 and sampled old normal use same declared V-flipped E/N basis approximately; source affine residual and actual loader transform still need runtime confirmation.
normalFrameAnalysis.Blender: Blender glTF importer/display may use a different V/normal mapping from OmaMalli; no Blender runtime executed here. Do not convert one-frame result into target acceptance.
normalFrameAnalysis.acceptance: Conditional source-frame consistency only. Exact active receiver loader/image/V handling and actual shader build must be pinned before normal direction acceptance.
